jobs.description:
Description:

The EDI Implementation Analyst will coordinate and support the full lifecycle of healthcare EDI implementations, from requirements gathering and data mapping through testing, deployment, and post-production stabilization. Reporting to the EDI Director, this role will partner with clients, health plans, vendors, and internal technical and operational teams to translate business requirements into accurate, scalable file solutions. The EDI Implementation Analyst will analyze enrollment and claims data, validate file configurations and results, manage implementation milestones and risks, and serve as a subject-matter resource to promote accurate, timely, and compliant data exchange.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead assigned EDI implementations from intake through post-production stabilization, maintaining requirements, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status updates
* Gather and document business, technical, and operational requirements with clients, health plans, vendors, and internal stakeholders
* Analyze companion guides, file layouts, and source data to define mappings, validations, transformations, and processing rules
* Coordinate file configuration and development activities with programming and technical teams, clarifying requirements and resolving implementation questions
* Create test plans, produce and validate test files, reconcile results, document defects, and confirm that acceptance criteria are met
* Facilitate client and partner testing, communicate findings, track issue resolution, and obtain implementation approvals
* Prepare implementation readiness and go-live documentation, coordinate production deployment, and monitor initial production file cycles
* Perform production data reconciliation and root-cause analysis to resolve enrollment, claims, and file-transfer discrepancies
* Maintain implementation documentation, mapping specifications, decision logs, standard operating procedures, and handoff materials
* Identify opportunities to standardize implementation practices, strengthen controls, and improve data quality and delivery timeliness
* Provide implementation guidance and knowledge transfer to enrollment, claims, operations, and support teams
* Support team coverage and complete other implementation projects as assigned by management

Requirements:

* Three to four years of experience supporting healthcare EDI implementations, integrations, or production operations
* Working knowledge of HIPAA X12 transactions, with experience in enrollment and claims data preferred
* Experience gathering requirements, interpreting companion guides and file layouts, and documenting mapping and processing rules
* Demonstrated ability to develop test scenarios, validate files, reconcile data, document defects, and perform root-cause analysis
* Strong project coordination, organization, and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple implementations and stakeholder priorities
* Familiarity with secure file transfer, ETL concepts, SQL or data-query tools, and development environments such as Visual Studio
* Self-starter with strong attention to detail and the ability to resolve complex implementation and data issues with minimal direction

**Benefits**

After successfully completing a waiting period, eligible Full-time employees have access to our comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Fantastic medical, dental, and vision insurance\*
* Twice annual employer HSA contributions, covering 50% of the HDHP plan’s annual deductible!
* Company provided Basic Life and AD&D
* Company paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability\*\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts\*
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with up to a 6% employer-match\*\* WOW! (100% fully vested after 3 years)
* 10+ paid holidays
* Fully Paid half day Summer Fridays
* Generous paid vacation and sick time
* Annual Paid Volunteer Day
* Annual Tuition Reimbursement
* Annual Health and Wellness Reimbursement
* Lots of fun company events
* 60 day waiting period

\*\*90 day waiting period

**Who We Are**

Cobalt Benefits Group has been named one of the *Best Companies to Work for in NH 2026* by NH Business Magazine! As a trusted third-party administrator (TPA) specializing in self-funded benefit plans, Cobalt Benefits Group (CBG) is committed to helping employers find high-quality coverage at a cost they can afford. We administer self-funded insurance benefits through our four lines of business: EBPA, Blue Benefit Administrators of Massachusetts, CBA Blue, and Great Bay Administrators. With over 30 years of experience and a dedicated team of more than 300 employees, we work collaboratively to build customized self-funded health plans, manage claim payments and disputes, and administer other specialized programs such as FSAs, HSAs, COBRA, and retiree billing. * $25 - $27 / HR or Annual less payroll deductions and all required withholdings
* Monday - Friday schedule 9a - 5p
* Weekends and holidays may be required

* Oversee the entire onboarding process of a rotating portfolio of homes, from submission of signed contracts through going public on our company website; including collection of information from homeowner(s) and coordination of all steps required. This includes but are not limited to:

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align departmental goals with broader organizational strategy.

* Experience working in hotel, hospitality, vacation or similar industry is highly preferred.

jobs.description:
**About Uplinq**

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control.

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

**Individual applicants residing in the US only**  
  
**About the role**

As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean-up, and account activation.

This is a high-touch, high-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.

The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

**What you'll do**

* Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow-through, not just technical accuracy.
* Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.
* Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.
* Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.
* Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.
* Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on-time, good-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.
* Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end-to-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years in a client-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher
* 6+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).
* Strong working knowledge of both cash- and accrual-based accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 25+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.
* A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.
* Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

**Why Join Us**

* Competitive pay + health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance
* Remote-first and flexible work culture
* Clear path for career growth in a fast-growing firm
* Modern tech stack and automation-first mindset
* Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

Compensation Range: $75,000-$85,000

jobs.description:
**About 3E:**
-------------

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

***Join us and make an impact!***

**About the Role**

As an Implementation Specialist at 3E, you’ll turn a signed customer contract into a working, adopted solution. You’ll own hands-on implementation activities from kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and handoff—helping customers reach measurable first value from 3E’s products.

This role combines technical implementation, customer engagement, and project coordination. You’ll translate the agreed scope of work into a practical delivery plan, configure customer environments using real customer data, coordinate with technical and cross-functional partners, and keep milestones, risks, dependencies, and customer commitments visible throughout the engagement.

You’ll also support post-onboarding Value Realization Projects that help customers expand or improve their use of 3E through activities such as migrations, integrations, data remediation, inventory and catalog optimization, and workflow enablement.

You’ll work closely with the broader account team with clear ownership: the Implementation Specialist owns implementation delivery, the CSM owns ongoing adoption, and the AM owns the commercial account.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer interaction, takes ownership of outcomes, and is comfortable working through changing priorities and ambiguity. Those characteristics also connect authentically with 3E's broader EVP around building, operating through ambiguity, and moving between planning and execution.

**Location:** This position supports remote work within the Eastern time zone.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead assigned customer implementations from internal handoff and kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and formal handoff.
* Conduct implementation discovery and help confirm customer data readiness, environment requirements, security considerations, and integration prerequisites.
* Translate the scope of work into a documented implementation plan with milestones, deliverables, dependencies, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Configure 3E customer environments, including inventory and structure, users and roles, integrations, and core workflows aligned with customer goals.
* Work directly with customer contacts and administrators to validate the solution and deliver foundational training.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical specialists, and external implementation partners as required for delivery.
* Track milestones and identify risks, dependencies, or potential scope changes early.
* Follow established change-control processes when customer requests extend beyond the agreed scope.
* Hold customers accountable for implementation commitments such as data readiness, resourcing, testing, and sign-offs.
* Execute post-onboarding Value Realization Projects such as migrations, data remediation, integrations, inventory optimization, and workflow enablement.
* Maintain accurate project records and documented handoffs while managing multiple concurrent implementations, keeping status, configuration, outcomes, risks, next steps, and training needs visible and prioritizing work based on customer impact, project risk, and key milestones.
* Build technical proficiency across 3E products and work credibly with technical teams to troubleshoot implementation issues and identify risks; coding is not required.
* Surface customer-identified bugs, product issues, and feature requests to the appropriate internal teams.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

**Required**

* 2-3 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.
* Strong technical aptitude with demonstrated ability to configure software, troubleshoot setup issues, and learn new products.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects or implementations to deadlines and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to translate customer requirements and agreed scope into clear implementation activities, milestones, and deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally and building productive customer relationships.
* Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort working with data and systems of record.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and changing customer needs.
* Willingness to travel 10–20%.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing or improving onboarding processes and customer journeys.
* Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk.
* Understanding of time-to-value, onboarding, adoption, or usage analytics.
* Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software.
* Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting customers across global markets.

This role must be based in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

**Our US Benefits Include:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Open PTO and parental leave
* 401(k) plan with company matching
* Employee assistance program
* Voluntary supplemental benefits (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness)

**3E is currently authorized to hire in the following U.S. states:**

Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding Los Angeles), Colorado (excluding Denver), Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois (excluding Chicago), Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York (excluding New York City), North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

**Disclosures:**

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us here

Candidate Privacy Notice

**Agencies**: 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

Visit our Website or follow us on LinkedIn

Compensation Range: $60K - $70K

#### **What is PerfectServe?**

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.  
  
PerfectServe's mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.  
  
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

* In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

* PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.  
  
If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Depending on the assignment, may require ordinary ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; or the ability to stand, walk and manipulate (lift, carry, move) light to medium weights of 10 - 25 pounds. Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, and operate equipment.

jobs.title: Implementation Lead - ASO Employer Health Benefits
jobs.description:
XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

**ABOUT XO HEALTH:**

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client and TPA Onboarding:**

* Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
* Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
* Own the accurate setup of each group across XO's systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

**Project Management:**

* Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
* Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
* Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

**Client Communication:**

* Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
* Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
* Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
* Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

**KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:**

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. * Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.

Training and Mentorship:
